summary: TMD Energy Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Malaysia/Singapore-based bunkering services provider listed on NYSE American (TMDE), furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, announcing its Annual General Meeting to be held October 7, 2026 in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia, with a record date of August 28, 2026. The notice, proxy statement, proxy card, and a second amended and restated memorandum and articles were filed as exhibits. Proposals cover reclassifying authorized capital into 400,000,000 Class A and 100,000,000 Class B shares, adopting amended articles, re-electing four directors, ratifying auditor J S Associate PLT, and authorizing adjournment. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; the dual-class reclassification merits governance monitoring but poses no event-driven arbitrage angle.
